up: Retrieve assay_chembl_id, tid, assay_description, target_name, target_organism, journal, year, volume, first_page, and doi for bioassays where assay_type is 'B' and tid is 165.
sql:
SELECT
  ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
  ass.tid,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.organism AS target_organism,
  d.journal,
  d.year,
  d.volume,
  d.first_page,
  d.doi
FROM assays ass
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN docs d ON ass.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE ass.assay_type = 'B'
  AND ass.tid = 165;
